calculation.description: 20-trading-day momentum (5-day skip) scaled by trailing 60-day realized volatility. Raw momentum is dominated by volatility; normalizing by vol isolates trend quality / risk-adjusted trend strength. High values indicate strong recent trend with low realized risk; low (negative) values indicate falling assets or choppy high-vol declines. Positive cross-sectional predictive power is strongest at 5-20d horizons and monotonic in horizon, indicating continuation of risk-adjusted trends.
calculation.python:
def vol_adj_mom_20_60(df, s):
    close = df['close']
    mom = close.shift(5) / close.shift(25) - 1.0
    vol = close.pct_change().rolling(60).std()
    return mom / vol

validation.regime_notes: Validated 2020-01-01..2026-07-15 on the 15-asset cross-asset universe (equity indices, commodities, crypto, yield series) across multiple regimes: COVID crash 2020, recovery bull 2020-21, 2022 tightening bear, 2023-24 AI-led equity rally, 2024-26 crypto/commodity cycles. Daily cross-sectional Spearman IC, min 8 valid instruments per date. Decay is monotone: 1d 0.016, 5d 0.040, 10d 0.054, 20d 0.059 -> trend-continuation signature.
